variants.briefing:
Hey, you!

I've got a beacon at [Location]. They say their tanks are running dry and they could use [FuelType]. If you're interested, I get the feeling they'll be really pleased to see you.

The client vessel will pay you at the rate of [RefuelRequest], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

They're stuck out in an area with a bad reputation, though things have been a bit more quiet recently. Still worth staying alert I'd say, just in case there's still trouble lurking out there. 

Either way, the sooner everyone's able to get flying again - and that includes you - the better.

Happy trails,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
